message.subject: Canon + protective films for PRINTING United
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Saw Canon is title sponsor at PRINTING United this October showcasing the Colorado XL-series—congrats on the launch.

I'm reaching out because we work with large-format printer manufacturers who want to differentiate on outdoor performance. We've helped companies extend their durability messaging from months to years with our protective film that prevents fading and cracking on vehicle wraps and architectural graphics.

Given your Colorado and Arizona focus on outdoor applications, would it make sense to explore how we might support Canon's ecosystem ahead of the expo? Happy to share what we're seeing work for similar product teams.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Canon's title sponsorship at PRINTING United Expo 2025 and Colorado XL-series launch creates natural timing for ecosystem partner discussions
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Extreme durability and UV protection that extends outdoor performance claims from months to years, enabling product differentiation
